title: シティコミューターバイク
description: ダイヤモンドフレーム、スポーク車輪、連続したリンクチェーン、クランク、ブレーキ、泥よけと荷台を備えた街乗り自転車。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 繰り返し部品は材質と構成単位ごとに統合済み。
descriptionEn: Unbranded commuter bicycle with diamond frame, cross-laced spokes, linked chain drive, cranks, pedals, rim brakes and cables, fenders, rear rack and lights. Static visualization assembly, not a rideable or engineering-validated design. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Repeated static details are grouped by material and assembly; the procedural source retains the editable construction.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
